package.description: Freeware PCB design and engineering calculator suite

en-US.description: Freeware PCB design and engineering calculator suite
en-US.longDescription: The Saturn PCB Toolkit is a freeware suite of calculators for PCB design and engineering. It includes tools for microstrip and stripline impedance, differential pairs, via current, conductor current, planar inductors, padstacks, crosstalk, Ohm's Law, and more, following industry specifications such as IPC-2152.
en-US.name: Saturn PCB Toolkit

zh-CN.description: 面向 PCB 设计与电子工程计算的免费工具套件
zh-CN.longDescription: Saturn PCB Toolkit 是一款免费的 PCB 设计计算工具套件，提供微带线（microstrip）与带状线（stripline）阻抗、差分对、过孔载流、导线载流、平面电感、焊盘叠层、串扰、欧姆定律等计算功能，并遵循 IPC-2152 等行业规范。
